| description = Her Majesty is the brood mother of the Sarnak and during the late Velious era opened her realm up to other races that have proper faction to serve her. The Sarnak are an artificial race created by combining Iksar and Dragon. After serving as slaves to the Iksar, they have gone feral. Her enemies include the Iksar race and [[Chief_RokGus|Chief RokGus]]'s Kunark Goblins. She is by far the hardest mob in [[Chardok]].  Beware, as she casts [[gate]].

=== Strategy ===

Queen has an area effect 850hp, 1 tick fire dot called [[Flame Song of Ro]]. The effect can be removed by a magic dispel spell/song/clicky if the debuff is in a top slot. The debuff is very difficult if not impossible to resist on P99.

However, aside from the tank, no one needs to be hit by the AoE.  The AoE happens once every 12 seconds, so don't engage until you get a precise timer on it.  Then, have someone in voice chat call out a countdown.  At 5 seconds remaining, all melees aside from the tank should be around the corner.  Then, the person calling the countdown should call the melees to re-engage and restart the timer and countdown.  Using a log parsing program like GINA can help with this, but don't get too reliant in case you're out of range of the message.  The AoE message is "<name> is immolated in flame."

At 20%, she will start casting Gate, so make sure to mana sieve before pushing her past this threshold, or have enough dps to blow her away.  Also, at low health, the Queen will enrage, which means that even during the push, your tank needs to be opposite the rest of the raid force so that the push can continue when enrage happens.
